## What are you trying to do?

Describe the situation rather than the solution. "I want to know when a long
task finishes while I am away" tells me more than "add webhooks".

## What happens now

What you do today instead, and why it is awkward.

## What you had in mind

Optional. If you already have a shape in mind, describe it — but the problem
above matters more.

## Would you be willing to work on it?

No obligation at all; it just helps to know.
